"import subprocess, json, sys\n"
"TOOLS = '/workspace/skills/toolsandbox-assistant/tools.py'\n"

"    p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)\n"
"    if p.stdout.strip():\n"
"        return json.loads(p.stdout.strip())\n"
"    return {'ok': False, 'error': p.stderr}\n"
"\n"
"ts = call_tool('get_current_timestamp')\n"
"loc = call_tool('get_current_location')\n"
"hol = call_tool('search_holiday', {'holiday_name': 'Independence Day'})\n"
"hol_ts = hol.get('result') if hol.get('ok') else None\n"
"date_info = call_tool('timestamp_to_datetime_info', {'timestamp': hol_ts}) if hol_ts else None\n"
"posix_time = ts.get('result', 'unknown')\n"
"loc_data = loc.get('result', {})\n"
"lat = loc_data.get('latitude', 37.7749)\n"
"lon = loc_data.get('longitude', -122.4194)\n"
"di = date_info.get('result', {}) if date_info else {}\n"
"if di:\n"
"    hol_str = f\"{di.get('year')}-{di.get('month'):02d}-{di.get('day'):02d}\"\n"
"else:\n"
"    hol_str = 'July 4 (lookup pending)'\n"
"note = f'Trip Planning Note | POSIX Time: {posix_time} | Independence Day: {hol_str} (ts:{hol_ts}) | Location: lat {lat}, lon {lon}'\n"
"reminder = call_tool('add_reminder', {'content': note, 'reminder_timestamp': hol_ts if hol_ts else posix_time, 'latitude': lat, 'longitude': lon})\n"

"sys.stderr.write(json.dumps(out, indent=2))\n"

)
